description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Comparison Funnel Chart Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 12, 2024 Developer: [Infortime] Main functions: 1. Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive the comparison funnel chart through the data model of Power BI to achieve dynamic data display. 2. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. 3. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. 4. Responsive design: The funnel chart can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. 5. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: -Market analysis: Display the distribution and comparison of different products or services in the market. -User behavior: Analyze the distribution of user behavior across different categories or time periods. -Financial report: displays the proportion of revenue, expenses, or profits. -Resource allocation: Display the allocation of resources across different departments or projects. This visualization object aims to provide Power BI users with an innovative and feature rich way of presenting data, helping them better understand and analyze data comparison situations.
